rationale: Ryan is building standardized infrastructure for physical capabilities across robotics and autonomous systems at PCCP, while Rakesh brings AI research expertise from Meta that could inform how intelligent systems interact with and learn from physical capabilities. Ryan's focus on federated workflow systems and protocol standardization pairs well with research-level thinking on ML systems, creating potential for exploring how AI research can validate or extend physical capability abstractions.
intro_message: Ryan George, meet Rakesh Ranjan — Ryan's building standardized protocols for physical capabilities in robotics, and Rakesh's AI research background at Meta could offer valuable perspective on how ML systems integrate with physical infrastructure.
